syllabus.title: Fundamentals to advanced
syllabus.blurb: Eighteen tracks run from the AWS account under the instance through flows, routing, resiliency, and the ecosystem.

syllabus.title: Architecture
syllabus.blurb: The 3D map and the flat fallback show Connect, Lex, Lambda, Kinesis, conversational analytics, and the CCP.

syllabus.title: Deployment
syllabus.blurb: Create the instance on purpose, then repeat it with CloudFormation, CDK, or Terraform. Every lesson has an IaC tab.

syllabus.title: Migration and cutover
syllabus.blurb: CUCM, UCCX, UCCE, Webex Contact Center, Genesys, and Avaya map onto Connect objects. The cutover sheet is a checklist, not a hero weekend.

syllabus.title: Configuration walkthroughs
syllabus.blurb: Twenty-four browser labs: flow builder, routing, Lambda, CTR, Erlang, pricing, IAM, SAML, hours, quotas, and the ecosystem map.

syllabus.title: Troubleshooting playbooks
syllabus.blurb: One fault, one hop, one capture, one change. The fault catalog is the playbook.

syllabus.title: Ports and protocols
syllabus.blurb: TCP 443 for signaling. UDP 3478 for softphone media. A firewall matrix and a mastery game sit beside the lesson.

syllabus.title: PSTN, porting, and external voice
syllabus.blurb: DID, toll-free, shared cost, and UIFN are the number types. Connect does not give you a CUCM SIP trunk page. The external voice connector is an analytics product with its own price and a default quota of 0.

syllabus.title: Workforce management
syllabus.blurb: Native forecasting and agent scheduling, plus the third-party path that reads agent events.

syllabus.title: Recording and quality
syllabus.blurb: S3 recordings, screen recording, Kinesis Video Streams for a live third-party recorder, and quality on conversational analytics.

syllabus.title: E911 and emergency calling
syllabus.blurb: US CCP agents: validate an address, store it, whisper it on 911, and test with 933. This lab never places a live 911 call.

syllabus.title: Reporting and analytics
syllabus.blurb: CTR fields, real-time and historical metrics, and conversational analytics, which the admin guide used to call Contact Lens.

syllabus.title: CRM and API integrations
syllabus.blurb: Salesforce CTI Adapter and SCC-AC, ServiceNow Voice, Microsoft Teams as a chat client, and CUCM kept beside Connect.

syllabus.title: AI agents and bots
syllabus.blurb: Lex V2, agent assist (formerly Amazon Q in Connect), and Agentic CX as a flow exit with a way back to a person.

syllabus.title: Security and compliance
syllabus.blurb: Security profiles versus IAM, KMS key policy, SAML attributes, quotas, and the 14 October 2026 price appendix.

syllabus.title: Licensing and certification
syllabus.blurb: There is no Amazon Connect specialty exam. Skill Builder badges pass at 80 percent. AWS Certification exams are a different catalog.

syllabus.title: Roadmap and what's new
syllabus.blurb: The timeline is cited through 2 September 2026. Anything published after the 14 October 2026 read of the pricing appendix is unverified on this campus.

syllabus.title: Real customer integrations
syllabus.blurb: The published patterns are Salesforce, ServiceNow, Teams, and a PBX beside Connect. A diagram of a SIP trunk into Teams Phone is not the AWS blog pattern.

syllabus.title: Interview prep and career paths
syllabus.blurb: Five roles, the exam or badge that matches each, and the per-track interview traps.

firewall.dest: The instance domain (*.my.connect.aws) and the other domains on the documented allow list
firewall.note: Option 1 in the network guide is a domain allow list. Option 2, the AWS IP ranges, is documented as not recommended.
The usual failure string names turn:TurnNlb and port 3478. Media should not hairpin through a VPN.

firewall.hop: Return media on a stateless firewall
firewall.note: There is no lasting pin. A stateless firewall has to allow the browser's ephemeral UDP range. The exact range depends on the OS, so this row does not invent a number.

firewall.dest: The same TURN name, resolved from the agent PC
firewall.note: ice_collection_timeout means the browser never gathered candidates. Resolve TurnNlb from that PC, not from a jump host.

firewall.dest: The domains in the allow list
firewall.note: Test more than 200 calls. An error rate above 2 percent points at proxy or DNS resolution.

firewall.dest: An Amazon Chime subnet, in addition to the softphone path
firewall.note: UNVERIFIED as a port list. The network lesson says video adds a Chime subnet and does not support VDI. Confirm the current port table on the video page before you ticket a firewall change.

cutover.title: Inventory
cutover.body: Write down numbers, queues, scripts or flows, skills, desktops, reports, recording paths, and the WFM feed. If it is not on the list, it will be rediscovered during the outage.

cutover.title: Map objects
cutover.body: Use the bridge table. A skill group, a CSQ, and a hunt pilot are not three names for one Connect queue. Say which Connect object each one becomes.

cutover.title: Build the instance
cutover.body: Region, identity, hours, queues, routing profiles, and flows whose error branches play a prompt. Logging on. One Lambda alias associated.

cutover.title: Pilot number
cutover.body: Claim or port one number. Keep the old platform able to take that traffic back. Porting uses the same Support path the quota page describes.

cutover.title: Dual-run
cutover.body: Move a small share. Compare one ContactId, one recording object in S3, one CTR, and one screen pop. Then compare them again the next morning.

cutover.title: Prove the agent network
cutover.body: From a real agent PC, not a jump host: TCP 443, UDP 3478, and an error rate under 2 percent across more than 200 calls.

cutover.title: Prove emergency calling
cutover.body: For US CCP agents, validate the address, store it, and read it back with 933. Do not place a live 911 call as a test.

cutover.title: Shift and watch
cutover.body: Increase traffic only after the pilot evidence exists. Keep the rollback number for a full business cycle.

cutover.title: Decommission
cutover.body: Turn off the old route only after recordings and CTR delivery have been seen for the contacts that moved.

careers.proof: Instance, hours, queues, routing profiles, security profiles, quotas.
careers.credential: Skill Builder badges (Communications Specialist, Fundamentals, administrator track), passed at 80 percent. Not a proctored Connect specialty exam.

careers.proof: Flow types, modules, the flow language JSON, Lex slots, and the 8-second Lambda contract.
careers.credential: Connect Developer badge, plus AWS Certified Developer - Associate if the work is Lambda and Streams.

careers.proof: Region pairs, Global Resiliency, IAM prefixes, KMS, S3, Kinesis fan-out.
careers.credential: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate is the closest catalog exam. There is still no Connect specialty.

careers.proof: Domain allow list, UDP 3478, stateless return traffic, VPN kept off the media path, VDI limits.
careers.credential: AWS Certified Advanced Networking - Specialty covers complex networks. Its last day to test is 31 December 2026.

careers.proof: Forecasting and agent scheduling, agent events, shrinkage, conversational analytics, evaluation forms.
careers.credential: The AI Fundamentals badge is context. It does not configure a flow. Pair it with the analytics and ecosystem tracks.

portsQuiz.q: Which port carries softphone media to TurnNlb?
portsQuiz.why: The CCP error text names turn:TurnNlb and UDP 3478.

portsQuiz.q: Which port carries CCP signaling to the instance?
portsQuiz.why: The domain allow list uses TCP 443 for the instance, telemetry, and transport.

portsQuiz.q: How long will a synchronous Lambda block wait?
portsQuiz.why: Synchronous invoke waits at most 8 seconds. The function timeout can be longer. The flow will not wait for it.

portsQuiz.q: When does the network guide tell you to suspect the proxy or DNS?
choices: Error rate above 2 percent after more than 200 calls
A toll-free number that has not ported
portsQuiz.why: Test more than 200 calls. An error rate above 2 percent points at proxy or DNS resolution.

portsQuiz.q: Which number do you dial to test US emergency calling from the CCP?
portsQuiz.why: 933 is the test readback. This campus does not ask you to place a live 911 call.

portsQuiz.q: How large is one Global Resiliency traffic shift?
choices: It flips 100 percent or not at all
portsQuiz.why: Traffic distribution groups move in 10 percent steps. Prove a small shift before a large one.

portsQuiz.q: What is the default concurrent chat quota, including idle chats?
choices: 500, shared with SMS, WhatsApp, and Apple Messages
portsQuiz.why: Idle chats still count. The default ceiling is 500.

portsQuiz.q: When did Voice ID support end?
portsQuiz.why: New customers stopped on 20 May 2025. Support ended on 20 May 2026.

portsQuiz.q: What upper figure does the campus cite for delivery through the Osaka replica?
portsQuiz.why: Osaka is the replica for Tokyo. Delivery through Osaka can take up to 20 seconds.

portsQuiz.q: What score does a Connect Skill Builder badge knowledge check require?
portsQuiz.why: The badges pass at 80 percent. They are not AWS Certification exams.

explorer.title: PSTN
explorer.body: The caller dials a DID, toll-free, shared-cost, or UIFN number. Porting uses the Support path on the quota page. Keep the old carrier as rollback until recordings exist on the new path.

explorer.title: Connect
explorer.body: The number is associated with a contact flow in one Region. The instance does not contain IAM, S3, Lambda, or Kinesis. It calls them.

explorer.title: Flow
explorer.body: Every error branch is a product decision. An unconnected error output ends the contact. Modules stop you copying the same checks into every flow.

explorer.title: Lex / Lambda
explorer.body: Get customer input returns an intent and slots. Copy slots into attributes or they vanish. Synchronous Lambda waits at most 8 seconds and must return a string map or JSON the block accepts.

explorer.title: Queue
explorer.body: Set working queue, then Transfer to queue. Priority is a number on the routing profile. A lower number is offered first. Delay holds the contact back from that profile.

explorer.title: CCP
explorer.body: The agent browser uses TCP 443 for signaling and UDP 3478 for media. If 3478 is blocked, the agent can be signed in and still hear nothing.

interview.q: Is there an Amazon Connect certification?
interview.a: Not a specialty exam on the AWS Certification catalog. Connect recognition is a Skill Builder badge at 80 percent. Say which badge, and do not call it certified.

interview.q: Why did the softphone fail when the agent was signed in?
interview.a: Signaling can succeed on TCP 443 while media fails on UDP 3478 to TurnNlb.

interview.q: What replaced Contact Lens and Amazon Q in Connect in 2026?
interview.a: On 4 August 2026 the admin guide renamed them conversational analytics and agent assist. IAM for assist still shows the wisdom prefix.

interview.q: How do you migrate a CUCM SIP trunk?
interview.a: You do not register Connect as a phone. The public number hits a flow. A transfer back to CUCM is Transfer to phone number, and attributes do not ride the PSTN.

interview.q: What is the honest multi-Region design?
interview.a: Global Resiliency in a published pair, shifted 10 percent at a time. A second instance you built by hand is not that pattern.

interview.q: Voice ID in a design written this year?
interview.a: Support ended 20 May 2026. Remove the blocks. Use a partner or a one-time password.
